after.rationale: The actual fep-074 forward/backward evidence equality transports positive backward evidence into the premise of the actual fep-072 filtering recursion, then identifies its weighted atoms on the same finite carrier. Zero evidence remains excluded.

The actual fep-125 pointwise Brier-excess identity identifies the sampled risk with squared error on the same finite law, allowing the actual fep-124 Laplace squared-risk bound to apply. Positive sample count and probability bounds remain explicit.

An attaining tree supplied by actual fep-130 is compared with the open-loop embedding from actual fep-131; its value-preservation law gives finite-depth closed-loop dominance over every embedded plan. Universal strict advantage and infinite-horizon optimality are not claimed.

The actual fep-146 Fisher/variance identity transports interval-wise positive Fisher information into the variance premise of actual fep-148 strict monotonicity and injectivity. Constant-statistic and degenerate-information cases are excluded by the stated positivity premise.

The actual fep-154 relaxation formula turns nonstationary initial mass into a strictly positive Lyapunov value; combined with the actual fep-155 derivative law and positive rates, this gives strict two-state decay. Stationary initial laws have zero derivative instead.

The actual fep-158 masked-evidence identity supplies the predictive-evidence denominator consumed by the actual fep-117 reduced posterior-odds formula on the same finite carrier. Required positive evidence and reference weights are retained.

Finite matrix propagation supplies unnormalized weights; native posterior reconstruction additionally requires an observation kernel and conditioning. No cross-endpoint equality, null-observation ratio, generic normalized-child-message theorem, or loopy convergence claim is made. Keep conceptual; any formal tag change requires a qualified witness and reviewed seal delta.

This does not assert a unique fixed pair or arbitrary-coupling contraction.

before.rationale: The symmetrization construction discharges exactly the symmetric-matrix hypothesis of the trace cancellation it is paired with, without claiming a continuum Clairaut theorem or smooth Hessian.

FEPComposed.fep146_positive_fisher_suppl.statement:
theorem fep146_positive_fisher_supplies_fep148_mean_injectivity
    {Outcome : Type*} [Fintype Outcome] [Nonempty Outcome]
    (family : ScalarExponentialFamily Outcome) (lower upper : ℝ)
    (hFisher : ∀ parameter ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < family.fisher parameter) :
    StrictMonoOn family.mean (Set.Icc lower upper) ∧
      Set.InjOn family.mean (Set.Icc lower upper)

FEPComposed.fep074_backwardEvidence_supp.statement:
theorem fep074_backwardEvidence_supplies_fep072_filter
    {State Observation : Type*} [Fintype State] [Fintype Observation]
    (prior : FiniteLaw State) (transition : FiniteKernel State State)
    (emission : FiniteKernel State Observation) (observation : Observation)
    (hBackward : 0 < backwardEvidence prior transition emission observation) :
    ∃ hForward : 0 < forwardEvidence prior transition emission observation,
      ∀ state, forwardFilter prior transition emission observation hForward state *
        backwardEvidence prior transition emission observation =
        forwardPrediction prior transition state * emission state observation

FEPComposed.fep112_consensus_fixed_pair_.statement:
theorem fep112_consensus_fixed_pair_is_equal
    {State : Type*} [Fintype State] (left right : FiniteLaw State)
    (hLeft : consensusLeft left right = left)
    (hRight : consensusRight left right = right) : left = right

FEPComposed.fep125_brier_identity_transf.statement:
theorem fep125_brier_identity_transfers_fep124_risk_bound
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (sampling : FiniteLaw Ω)
    (successes : Ω → ℕ) (sampleCount : ℕ) (target : ℝ)
    (hCount : 0 < sampleCount) (hSuccess : ∀ o, successes o ≤ sampleCount)
    (hTarget : target ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    brierExcessRisk sampling
        (fun o => laplaceEstimate (successes o) sampleCount) target ≤
      2 * shrinkage sampleCount ^ 2 * expectation sampling
        (fun o => (empiricalRate (successes o) sampleCount - target) ^ 2) +
        2 * (1 / ((sampleCount : ℝ) + 2)) ^ 2

FEPComposed.fep154_nonstationary_relaxat.statement:
theorem fep154_nonstationary_relaxation_supplies_fep155_strict_decay
    (rates : TwoStateRates) (initial : FiniteLaw Bool)
    (nonstationary : initial true ≠ rates.stationaryTrue) (time : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (rates.lyapunov initial)
      (-2 * rates.decayRate * rates.lyapunov initial time) time ∧
      -2 * rates.decayRate * rates.lyapunov initial time < 0

FEPComposed.fep130_attaining_tree_domina.statement:
theorem fep130_attaining_tree_dominates_fep131_embedded_plans
    {Belief Action Observation : Type*}
    [Fintype Belief] [Fintype Action] [Fintype Observation] [Nonempty Action]
    (model : PolicyTreeModel Belief Action Observation) (depth : ℕ) (belief : Belief) :
    ∃ tree : PolicyTree Action Observation depth,
      policyTreeValue model tree belief = optimalTreeValue model depth belief ∧
      ∀ plan : OpenLoopPlan Action depth,
        policyTreeValue model tree belief ≤ openLoopValue model plan belief

FEPComposed.fep158_masked_evidence_suppl.statement:
theorem fep158_masked_evidence_supplies_fep117_reduced_odds
    {Parameter Evidence : Type*} [Fintype Parameter] [Fintype Evidence]
    (prior : FiniteLaw Parameter) (weight : Parameter → ℝ)
    (kernel : FiniteKernel Parameter Evidence) (data : Evidence)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ weight x) (hZ : 0 < ∑ x, weight x * prior x)
    (hE : 0 < maskedEvidence prior weight kernel data)
    (favored reference : Parameter) (hwref : 0 < weight reference)
    (hpref : 0 < prior reference) (hlref : 0 < kernel reference data) :
    ∃ hy : 0 < kernel.predictive (maskedPrior prior weight hw hZ) data,
      FEP.LearningTheory.posteriorOdds (maskedPrior prior weight hw hZ) kernel data hy favored reference =
        ((weight favored * prior favored) / (weight reference * prior reference)) *
          (kernel favored data / kernel reference data)
